assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished 2D background image for a Unity hybrid casual educational puzzle game, landscape 1536x1024 or wider. Create an orthographic top-down soft 3D clay/toy meadow game board environment. Rounded little low-poly toy trees, tufts, pebbles only at the far outer edges, a very small pale aqua stream tucked against the extreme right edge, gently raised grass perimeter corners with soft ambient occlusion. Premium polished mobile puzzle game background, warm friendly pastel palette, smooth chunky sculpted forms, soft contact shadows, no black outlines. Entire scene seen directly from above, no horizon, no perspective convergence. The interior remains quiet and almost flat in color. No roads crossing the play area. No buttons, no panels, no letters, no numbers, no interface, no characters, no watermark. Output only the background artwork filling the whole rectangular image.
